cards.t: Binance Resumes Withdrawals in Phases Following Hack
cards.b: Binance has started reopening customer withdrawals in phases following a record $6.3 billion exploit, with Bitcoin leading the first phase.

per.BNB: Impacted by exchange hack recovery efforts and phased withdrawal resumption.
per.BTC: Leads the first phase of resumed withdrawals on Binance following the security incident.

cards.label: STRONG CATALYST
cards.missing: Exact timeline for all remaining network withdrawals to fully reopen.

cards.t: Moscow Exchange Plans Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT Trading
cards.b: The Moscow Exchange plans to launch trading for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and USDT starting December 1 under new Russian crypto rules.

per.BTC: Scheduled to begin trading on the Moscow Exchange on December 1, 2026.
per.ETH: Scheduled to begin trading on the Moscow Exchange on December 1, 2026.
per.USDT: Scheduled to begin trading on the Moscow Exchange on December 1, 2026.

cards.label: MODERATE CATALYST
cards.missing: Specific trading pairs and volume caps.
